# AltMaster: Free Alt Text Checker + Shopify Alt Text Automation
> AltMaster is a free alt text checker for any URL, paired with a Shopify app that auto-generates SEO-friendly alt text for every product image.

## What AltMaster is
AltMaster has two parts:
1. A free web-based alt text checker at https://altmaster.io/ — paste any public URL and instantly see which images have alt text, which are missing it, and which use empty alt (alt="").
2. A Shopify app at https://apps.shopify.com/alt-text-optimizer — installs on any Shopify store and auto-generates SEO-friendly alt text for every product image. Bulk, automatic, undoable. Free to install.

## Who it's for
- Shopify merchants whose product images are missing alt text
- SEO practitioners auditing image accessibility on storefronts and landing pages
- Accessibility-conscious site owners checking WCAG / ADA compliance for images

## Why alt text matters
- Image SEO: Google uses alt text to understand and rank images in Google Images and product search results
- Accessibility: Screen readers rely on alt text to describe images to visually impaired users (WCAG, ADA)
- Resilience: Alt text shows in place of the image when it fails to load
- Shopify discovery: Product alt text feeds Google Shopping, social previews, and broken-image fallbacks

## How the free checker works
Paste any public URL. The tool fetches the page server-side via a proxy and scans every <img> tag in the initial server-rendered HTML. It reports:
- Total images detected
- Images with descriptive alt text
- Images missing the alt attribute entirely
- Images with empty alt (alt="") — valid only for purely decorative images
Coverage percentage and a per-image breakdown are shown.

## Limitations of the free checker
- Reads the initial server-rendered HTML only. Images injected later by JavaScript (some React/Vue SPAs, lazy carousels, third-party app widgets) are not detected
- Only public URLs work. Pages behind login, password-protected stores, and dev preview URLs cannot be scanned
- Some sites block automated requests; the tool tries multiple proxies but may still fail on hardened sites

## Shopify app (AltMaster)
The companion Shopify app at https://apps.shopify.com/alt-text-optimizer scans an entire Shopify store and auto-generates SEO-friendly alt text for every product image. Bulk fill on install, automatic for new products added afterward, fully undoable. Free to install.
